site.title: Mario Madersbacher — Security Researcher
site.description: Security researcher and web penetration tester (HTB CWES) from Tyrol, Austria. Three CVEs, merged fixes in Impacket, Scapy, Volatility 3 and ffuf, accepted bug-bounty reports. Every claim links to its public record.

person.name: Mario Madersbacher
person.headline: Security Researcher · Web Penetration Tester (HTB CWES)
person.intro: I find bugs in software people actually run — npm libraries, the tooling this field depends on, and web applications under bug-bounty programs — and report them so they get fixed. Still in secondary school; Matura in June 2027.
person.principle: Severity here is only ever what was demonstrated. A CVSS vector on this page was reproduced, not estimated.

cves.mechanism: Regular-expression denial of service in the IPv6 host-extraction regex, reachable through the default `anchorme()` export. A crafted URL of under 100 bytes backtracks exponentially and blocks the Node.js event loop.
cves.status: No fixed release as of October 2026 — npm latest is still 3.0.8.
cves.credit: Credited as finder under my real name on the CVE record.

cves.mechanism: O(n²) parsing in `lib/addressparser` on comment-joined addresses. Remotely triggerable without authentication through **mailparser** on inbound mail: a standards-compliant message stalls the event loop for seconds.
cves.status: Reported through GitHub's private advisory with PoC and a suggested fix; patched by the maintainer in 10.0.5.
cves.credit: Credited as reporter on the GitHub advisory and as finder on the CVE record.

cves.mechanism: The `case_name` request parameter reaches `os.system()` unsanitised in `py/web.py` (`controller_listen` / `controller_recover`).
cves.status: Vendor contacted, no response; published through VulDB.
cves.credit: Credited as reporter under the handle Telqrrr.

contributions.what: `parallel` set through a config file aborted every run with an unwrap panic (#1321). Rust; fix plus regression test.
Raw request files without a trailing newline silently lost their last header; brought the parser in line with the preflight path, with tests.
Made the test suite pass on Windows — three root causes, one of them a pipe-buffer deadlock in the stdout capture that only showed up as a hang.
BGP NLRI dissector crashed on a prefix shorter than its mask claims.
`IP6ListField` crashed on a truncated trailing IPv6 address — a field shared by about 17 dissectors (DHCPv6, ICMPv6, SRv6).
`BootpDecoder` raised `struct.error` on BOOTP messages shorter than RFC 1542's 300-octet minimum (#1900). Handled per the RFC, with regression tests.
Entry for Vssadmin.exe deleting shadow copies (MITRE T1490).
NSH MD-Type 2 context headers failed to dissect (`count_from` given a string); redone per RFC 8300 with proper length handling.
OPC DA layer: `STDOBJREF.IPID` and `OpcDaFack.selack` were declared with field classes where packet classes belong, so dissection raised `TypeError`.
Bluetooth `Set_Extended_Advertise_Enable` returned one advertising set regardless of `num_sets`.
The capabilities plugin failed on Linux kernels before 6.3 — fixed the structure handling.
An architecture typo blocked `scheduled_tasks` on 32-bit memory images.
Template for CVE-2020-10204 (Nexus Repository Manager 3 RCE), verified against a live instance.
NBNS name-query responses only returned the first address record; every entry is parsed now.
Detection rule: Kerberos pre-authentication disabled on a user account — the precondition for AS-REP roasting.

bounty.lead: Program names stay out by policy; the platform profiles are the record.

items.what: Unauthenticated third-party proxy endpoint on a major European electronics retailer exposing ~9.1 M customer trade-in records (name, IMEI, contact, payout) across seven EU storefronts.

Improper access control on an internal Confluence instance (resolved); SQL injection in a public geo API (accepted); unauthenticated Grafana/Mimir/Loki observability stack with tenant enumeration (closed as informational).
XSS chain on an Austrian price-comparison site.

bullets: Endpoint and printer deployment across hospital sites.
Network troubleshooting in a NAC and central-DHCP environment.
Administered the Wazuh SIEM. Wrote and live-verified ~20 custom Active Directory detection rules — DCSync, Kerberoasting, privileged-group changes, MITRE T1098 — with SID-based escalation.
Analysed a 35 M-event index; root-caused a KDC event storm (RC4/AES mismatch) and MS-SQL / pass-the-hash false positives, cutting alert noise by ~90 %.
CIS baseline and vulnerability assessments on domain controllers; escalated unpatched critical CVEs (RD Licensing RCE, CVSS 9.8).
Designed log retention (90 d hot / 12 mo snapshots) and wrote the SIEM operations handbook; inventoried ~700 assets into Snipe-IT; VLAN configuration on HPE Aruba Instant On switches.

projects.name: Argus
projects.meta: CAASM appliance for school networks · diploma thesis 2025–2027 · Rust + Next.js · source private
projects.what: Cyber-asset attack-surface management built for Austrian public-school networks. Rust backend (9 crates) and Next.js frontend, ~75 k LOC. Discovers assets over ARP, LLDP, SNMP and DHCP, correlates findings against CISA KEV, and prioritises with a criticality/exposure model. Ships as a signed, air-gapped offline deployment (Docker bundle → Proxmox VM). Evaluation framework: Cohen's κ, ROC-AUC, risk-reduction metrics. Approved by the Tyrolean Board of Education; piloting on a live school network with a Raspberry Pi in-network sensor.
